title: Thank you Eugenia!!❤️
text: This was the most awesome experience! It was a moderate to strenuous hike so be prepared for alot of stairs and steep climbs however, if you are able to do this it is well worth your time. It was absolutely breathtaking. Eugenia was one of the best guides we've ever had! It was like hiking with a friend. She was so patient with me as I have some mobility issues that slowed me down, however, she did everything right, supporting me and evaluating me continually to make sure I was ok along the way. One of our best hikes ever!!❤️
author: Allen_H
